title: The Moon as an anomalous alien spacecraft (unreleased Decatur interview)

tellings.quote: a lot of it was around how the moon is possibly this anomalous like alien spacecraft.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, recalls an interview, recorded around 2023 near Decatur outside Atlanta and never released, with a researcher named Randall Carlson. Michels says much of that talk was about the idea that the Moon may be an anomalous alien spacecraft rather than a natural body. If true, it would mean something built has been hanging in our sky all along.
